description:
Game analytics for the developer, read `_najpierw` first: one verdict (`wyrok`, `en.verdict`) and the top tasks with a reason and a fix (`dlaczego`/`jak`, `en.why`/`en.how`). Then: `lejek` = the session funnel the klyo kit records with NO code in the game (wejscie = opened the game page, start = pressed Play, gotowa = klyo.ready() with average load ms for phone and computer, ruch = first real move, gra30 = 30 s of visible play, koniec = round finished (with or without a score), dalej = went on to the next game from the end screen, wynik = reached a score), each step with `sesji`, `telefon`, `komputer` and `odpada` (sessions lost at this step, the answer to WHERE players leave); `poziomy` from klyo.level(n, "start"|"complete"|"fail") with start, koniec (completed) and porazka (fail) per level; `zdarzenia` from klyo.event(name, value) with count and sum; `mapa` = click map on a 24 × 16 grid of the game screen (`komorki` = [cell index, clicks], index = row × 24 + column, separate portrait and landscape) collected by the kit with no code; `sesje` = the latest sessions WITHOUT any person (country, phone or computer, time, play seconds, rounds, score, returning; the player tag is stable only within this game); `kraje` and `rozklad` (how long sessions lasted). Fix what `_najpierw` says (klyo_fix_game, klyo_game_patch, a new version) and ask again after the next players. Read-only.

Examples:
• Why do players leave my game?
• On which level do people quit lantern-thief?
• Where do players click in my game, and how long does it load on phones?

dni.description: How many days of the daily series (default 30).

slug.description: Game address in the catalogue, for example lantern-thief (from klyo_my_games).

sprawdz_google.description: Ask Google about this game's pages now (URL Inspection), at most once an hour per game. Each page then carries `sprawdzono` (when we asked) and `odwiedziny` (Google's last crawl). Google has no API to request indexing of an ordinary page: the sitemap already submits it, and the Request indexing button lives in Search Console.

name: klyo_game_analytics
title: Why players leave: game analytics
